displayName: ASOS API - Prices by Country and Currency, Stock by Size, Reviews
description: ASOS API for ASOS prices by country and currency - one ASOS product's price, previous price, RRP, sale flag and online stock by size in each ASOS store and currency (product ids are the same in every store); stock takes up to 100 product ids per call. Keyword search, product detail with every size variant, reviews by store with ASOS's AI summary, search suggestions, categories and the category tree, the A-Z brand list, the sale and new-in lists, and the markets table. 235 countries, 245 country-currency combinations. 11 endpoints, 1 credit per call. No physical stores (ASOS has none), no outlet, no promo codes, no price history (poll).

semanticRubric.prompt: Did the agent validate API outcomes instead of assuming success?
Did the agent preserve evidence for request/response behavior and error handling?
